conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame = world origin = footprint centre.
conventions.footprint: screen-px bounding size [w, h] of the ground footprint, centred on the anchor.
conventions.topPx: visual height above the anchor in px (bubbles / emotes).
conventions.shadows: baked soft cool shadow falling screen down-right (same as assets/props).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the sprite anchor (unscaled sprite).
conventions.seatPoints: where a SITTING villager's anchor goes (villager sit anims put the anchor at the front-centre of a 0.45 m seat). seatDirs[i] = facing of seat i (S, SE, SW...; SW/W = the SE/E frames flipped).
conventions.seatDepth: "front": draw the sitter just above the prop (sitter depth = prop depth + 1; benches, logs, swing); with several sitters on one prop add a tiny bias by seat dy (larger dy = nearer = drawn later). "behind": normal anchor-y sort already puts the sitter behind the prop (picnic table: the table top hides the lap). bench_seats.petPoints: draw the pet BELOW the bench sitters (it sits further back on the seat).
conventions.gatherPoints: notice_board: anchors where villagers stand to read / chat (gatherDirs = facing).
conventions.performPoint: music_stand: where the bard stands behind the stand (perform_S).
conventions.doorPoint: dog_house / igloo: ground point in front of the door (pet / kid anchor).
conventions.pullPoint: sled: the rope loop on the snow.
conventions.hidePoints: snow_fort: character anchors behind the wall (normal y-sort hides their legs).
conventions.workPoints: snowman: where kids stand while building (workDirs = facing).
conventions.stages: snowman_0..3 share frameSize + anchor: swap the frame in place as it is built.
conventions.anims: frame lists inside atlas life_props (names may repeat); the swing anim also lists a seatPoint per frame so a sitting kid can ride along.
conventions.bench_seats: override entry for the existing props bench (not an image): {of, seatPoints, seatDirs, petPoints, seatDepth}.
conventions.layouts: suggested arrangements (offsets in px from the named centre sprite anchor).

snowman_0.notes: Snowman building stages (0 gathered snow + first ball, 1 big ball + 2nd ball rolled beside it, 2 three balls stacked with carrot/bucket ready on the snow, 3 finished: coal eyes + smile, carrot nose, rosy cheeks, striped red scarf, blue bucket hat, stick arms). All 4 frames share frameSize + anchor: swap the frame in place as kids build it. workPoints = where kids stand to build (anchors).

snowball_pile.notes: Pyramid of ready-made snowballs on a little snow mound (ammo for snowball fights).

snow_fort.notes: Low curved wall of snow bricks (~2 m, 0.68 m high) with crenels, a red pennant and snowballs. Convex side faces the camera. hidePoints = character anchors BEHIND the wall (kids hide there and throw snowballs toward screen-down); normal y-sort already draws them behind the wall, which covers them up to the chest.

log_seat.notes: Log bench for the campfire circle: 1.6 m log on two chocks, planed seat at 0.45 m. seatPoints = where a sitting villager anchor goes (seat front-centre, 2 seats); seatDirs = which way the sitter faces; seatDepth "front" = draw the sitter just above the log (depth = log depth + 1). This one runs screen-horizontal: sitters face the camera (S). Put it on the far side of a campfire.

log_seat_x.notes: Log bench for the campfire circle: 1.6 m log on two chocks, planed seat at 0.45 m. seatPoints = where a sitting villager anchor goes (seat front-centre, 2 seats); seatDirs = which way the sitter faces; seatDepth "front" = draw the sitter just above the log (depth = log depth + 1). Runs along world X (screen down-right): sitters face SW (use sit_SE flipped). Put it on the upper-right side of a campfire.

log_seat_y.notes: Log bench for the campfire circle: 1.6 m log on two chocks, planed seat at 0.45 m. seatPoints = where a sitting villager anchor goes (seat front-centre, 2 seats); seatDirs = which way the sitter faces; seatDepth "front" = draw the sitter just above the log (depth = log depth + 1). Runs along world Y (screen up-right): sitters face SE. Put it on the upper-left side of a campfire.

sled.notes: Kids' wooden sled: slatted deck on red curled runners, red rope. Curl/front points screen down-right (world +X). pullPoint = rope loop on the snow (where a kid holds it when pulling).

dog_house.notes: Small dog house: red gabled roof with snow, light plank walls, arched door facing the camera, bone-shaped name plate (no text), food bowl + bone. doorPoint = where the dog sits/lies in front of the door (pet anchor).

picnic_table.notes: Picnic table with attached benches (table 0.70 m, seats 0.45 m), snow on top and two cocoa mugs. Long axis runs screen-horizontal. seatPoints are on the FAR bench only (sitters face the camera, S); seatDepth "behind" = normal y-sort, the table top then hides their laps.

lantern_string.notes: Two wooden posts with a sagging string of warm glowing bulbs (festive plaza decor), runs screen-horizontal. anims.twinkle = 4-frame chase loop (frame 0 = the static frame). fxPoints.bulbs = bulb centres (px from the anchor) if the game wants extra fx_glow (ADD blend) on top.

kids_swing.notes: Kids' A-frame swing (beam 2 m) with a red seat at 0.45 m; sitters face the camera (S). anims.swing = 8-frame pendulum loop (frame names repeat; only 4 extra images). seatPoints = rest seat; anims.swing.seatPoints[i] = seat point in frame i -> move the sitting kid with it (seatDepth "front": draw the kid just above the swing).

ice_rink.notes: Frozen pond for skating / sliding kids: glossy pale-blue ice with skate swirls and a soft snow rim (~0.1 m). Flat: draw it on the ground layer UNDER characters (not y-sorted with them). footprint = the walkable ice area.

clothesline.notes: Two T-posts with a washing line: red mittens, a blue sweater, a striped scarf and yellow socks (cosy village life). Runs screen-horizontal.

igloo.notes: Kids' snow-brick igloo (1.6 m dome, 0.95 m tall) with an entrance tunnel facing the camera. doorPoint = in front of the tunnel (a kid can pop in / out: fade the sprite at the door).

notice_board.notes: Village notice board (blank pinned notes, no baked text) under a small red roof: a natural chat spot. gatherPoints = where 2-3 villagers stand to read / chat (anchors; gatherDirs = facing).

music_stand.notes: Little music stand with a song sheet (for the bard by the campfire). performPoint = where the bard stands behind it facing the camera (play perform_S there; the desk covers his belly).

bench_seats.notes: Seat points for the existing props bench (not re-rendered): 2 seats on the front (-Y, screen down-left) edge, sitters face SW (sit_SE flipped). petPoints = middle of the seat (cat loaf). Bench seat top is 0.55 m (sit poses are modelled for 0.45 m: legs dangle a little more).

campfire_circle.notes: Three log seats in a U behind the existing props campfire: place each sprite anchor at campfire anchor + offset (px). All 6 sitters face the fire (log_seat: S, log_seat_y: SE, log_seat_x: SW = sit_SE flipped). Leave the camera side open for the bard / dancers.
